description.value: The Jolly Coachman is a long-standing neighbourhood pub and liquor store nestled in Pitt Meadows, serving the community with daily food specials, craft beer on tap, and a happy hour menu. It has a community-focused identity with Lions Club ties, meat draws, and local fundraisers. A touring cyclist passing through the Pitt Meadows area would find a full sit-down pub menu alongside an attached liquor store.
